name: Cua Ca Mau
summary: Cua Cà Mau is the mangrove crab. Meat crab is firm and sweet. Roe crab is full and rich. Order it steamed, rang me, or as lẩu cua.
origin: The Ngọc Hiển page and the Vietnam Airlines page both name meat crab and roe crab from the cape and the city. No restaurant is named.
taste: The Ngọc Hiển page says meat crab is firm and sweet, and roe crab is full and rich. The airline page says the same pair.
howToEat: Order it steamed, stir-fried with tamarind, or as a crab hotpot.
Eat it as a main meal on the cape day or back in the city.
A season for the best crab was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Đất Mũi and the city. No restaurant is named, and no stall price is printed. Check on arrival.
